description:
A music player that respects what's yours.

Noctis is a desktop music player for your local library — fast browsing,
synced lyrics, metadata editing, EQ, and more.
Discord
Download
Pick your platform from the Assets below:
────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Platform│Files
────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows │Noctis-v1.4.5-Setup.exe (installer) · Noctis-windows-x64.zip (portable)
────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS   │Noctis-osx-arm64.dmg (Apple Silicon) · Noctis-osx-x64.dmg (Intel)
────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux   │Noctis-x86_64.AppImage · Noctis-linux-x64.tar.gz ·
        │Noctis-linux-arm64.tar.gz
────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> Running on macOS — the app isn't code-signed, so Gatekeeper quarantines it on first launch. After dragging Noctis into your Applications folder, clear the flag once in Terminal:
>
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Noctis.app
>
> Then open Noctis normally.
What's Changed
Fixed
- Fixed pinned sidebar cutting off right side of views
- Fixed ghost audio after quitting app
- Fixed EQ custom adjust overshooting to 300% volume
- Fixed audio dead after unplugging headphones/speaker
- Fixed full volume after switching audio devices
- Fixed Linux next track silent after long pause
- Fixed middle-click autoscroll judder
Added
- Added Keep sidebar expanded toggle in Settings
- Added Open File With for tracks (external app launch)
- Added F2 as alternate fullscreen key
- Added EQ preamp slider (−12..+6 dB)
Improved
- Improved Add Songs selection circles styling
- Improved middle-click autoscroll smoothness (frame-clock driven)
- Improved hover-expand toggle grayed out when pin is on
Full Changelog: v1.4.4...v1.4.5
